blocks.text: Love has a way of bringing out the best in us and dragging our deepest fears along for the ride. Out now, alt-pop singer-songwriter eaJ releases his six-track EP, ‘the responsibility of being in love’, via Position Music, exploring how love can change the way we see ourselves while forcing us to confront the parts we would rather leave behind. The EP’s focus track, “anxiety” (produced by Inverness), carries forward the self-discovery that marked eaJ’s return with previous singles “feel myself” and “blinded”, channeling the spiralling inner monologue of a panic attack through high-energy alt-pop and hyperpop.
